comparison.objective: Unload a soup tray from a pass and serve the bowl onto a placemat.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually slide, carry, and lower a loaded tray while suppressing tilt and spill.
comparison.success_condition: Tray lies flat, bowl stands on placemat, and no more than 10 ml is spilled; major tipping fails.
comparison.reason: Tests load leveling and spill control, not precision impact or material separation.
